subject: revts reject to draw tree with a collapsed branch

messages.author: b7a46c53a2fcd90c
messages.subject: revts reject to draw tree with a collapsed branch
parts:
Hello,

I try to collapse a branch in my tree. If I draw the tree it is OK, but if I try to revert x axis with revts() then I get warning telling:

***
Warning message:
Removed 1 rows containing missing values (geom_point_g_gtree).
***

The code I use is: 

p <- (ggtree(timetree, right=T)) %>% collapse(node=171) + geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==171)), shape=23, size=5, fill='red')

Can you please tell how to solve the problem?

Best,
Hovhannes

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: revts reject to draw tree with a collapsed branch
